formative_worksheets.title: The Compare and Calendar Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check.
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check confirming attribute identification and length/mass comparison before introducing calendar.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can name attributes and compare objects.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can name attributes and compare objects.
header.character_watermark: Roo the Ruler Rabbit in the top-right corner with a clipboard. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: Name the attribute (length / area / mass / capacity) for each object.
prompts.visual_layout: 4 object icons with writing lines below each.

image_placeholders.description: 4 object icons in a row for a Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. From left: pencil, book, rock, cup. Each ~1.2in. Beside each, a writing line for the attribute.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q1_OBJECTS at Prompt 1: instructions ask the child to name attributes. Keywords name the activity.

prompts.answer_key: Pencil: length. Book: area. Rock: mass. Cup: capacity.

prompts.prompt: Order 3 strips from shortest (1) to longest (3).
prompts.visual_layout: 3 strips of varied length aligned at left edge.

image_placeholders.description: 3 horizontal strips for a Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. Lengths in mixed order: 2in, 4in, 1in. Aligned at left edge with number boxes.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q2_STRIPS at Prompt 2: instructions ask the child to order strips. Keywords name the elements.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling about measurement? Circle the face.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for a Grade 1 formative check. Smile, neutral, frown. Each ~1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: instructions ask the child to circle a face. Keywords name the visual.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child.

reflection_sheet.title: My Measurement Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Roo and Cal in the top-right corner with a Junior Measure-Master certificate. References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Measure-Master? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals for a Grade 1 reflection. 1, 2, 3 stars with labels.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_STARS at Prompt 1: keywords name the rating and role.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row YES/NO table for a Grade 1 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_YN_TABLE at Prompt 2: keywords name the response options.

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for a Grade 1 reflection. Above: 'My favourite measurement activity was...'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_FAV_BOX at Prompt 3: keywords name the focus.

prompts.prompt: The trickiest part for me was...

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for a Grade 1 reflection. Above: 'The trickiest part for me was...'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_TRICKY_BOX at Prompt 4: keyword matches the prompt.

prompts.prompt: Next time, I want to try...

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for a Grade 1 reflection. Above: 'Next time, I want to try...'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_NEXT_BOX at Prompt 5: keywords name the focus.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at the end of Lesson 5. Children may need scribe support.
